title: Why is crypto up today? Thursday, October 15, 2026
h1: Why is crypto up today? Thursday, October 15, 2026
answer: The desk published no new stories today, so this edition is built entirely from its own market boards.
Those boards show bitcoin at $82,119, up 0.8% on the day but down 2.0% over the week and up 4.4% over the month, a divergence the desk's own window-sign table flags explicitly.

ETF flows stayed negative, with bitcoin ETFs posting a net outflow of $137.6 million over the week and ether ETFs a net outflow of $264.5 million over the week, even as the Whale Watch board shows $51,371,224 in bitcoin moving off exchanges in the last 24 hours, a reading set against four straight prior weeks of bitcoin moving onto exchanges per the same board.
No regulatory storyline the desk tracks reached a new checkpoint today; their next steps remain as previously dated in the desk's own reporting.

reported.line: Brooklyn DA and FBI dismantled Russian-language crypto scam network, seizing 112 servers and shutting 241 domains after victims lost tens of millions.
EU banking authority classified Circle's USDC as 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, activating Nov. 12 supervisory rules.
Australia's ASIC proposed stricter rules for crypto exchange licensing, including capital and custody requirements due ahead of 2027 rollout.
Russia's Central Bank confirmed ban on direct P2P crypto trades effective July 1, 2027, requiring residents to use authorized intermediaries.
Hot US producer-price data triggered nearly $940 million in crypto liquidations as Fed rate-hike bets spiked to 50%.
